US.description: Covers typical expenses for groceries, transportation, utilities, and miscellaneous personal spending.

IN.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities, reflecting a generally affordable lifestyle.

SG.description: High cost of living, with significant expenses for groceries, dining out, and transportation. Utilities are moderately priced.

CH.description: Cost of living is exceptionally high, particularly for groceries, transportation, and dining out.

NL.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and daily expenses.

GB.description: Reflects costs for groceries, transportation, utilities, and general entertainment, averaged across the country.

CA.description: Overall cost of living is moderate to high, with groceries, transportation, and utilities being significant expenses, particularly in major urban centers.

AE.description: Moderate to high cost for groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities, varying by lifestyle, with Dubai being on the higher end.

NO.description: Very high cost of living for groceries, dining out, and transportation, making it one of the most expensive countries globally.

IE.description: Cost of living is high, particularly for groceries, utilities, and transportation, especially in urban centers.

LU.description: High cost of groceries, utilities, and services, though public transport is free.

AU.description: Covers average monthly expenses for groceries, transport, utilities, and personal care for a single person.

QA.description: The cost of living excluding rent is moderate, benefiting from subsidized utilities. Groceries and dining out can range from moderate to high depending on choices.

BN.description: Cost of living, excluding rent, is moderate. Groceries, utilities, and local transport are generally affordable.

MO.description: Cost of living is high, especially for imported goods and dining, but public transport and some local amenities can be more affordable.
